name: AKTEN
indications_original: AKTEN is indicated for ocular surface anesthesia during ophthalmologic procedures in adults and pediatric patients.
contraindications_original: The recommended dose of AKTEN is 2 drops applied to the ocular surface in the area of the planned procedure. AKTEN may be reapplied to maintain anesthetic effect.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
AKTEN (lidocaine hydrochloride ophthalmic gel) 3.5% is supplied as a clear gel in single-patient-use tubes as follows:
                  
                     
                        
                        
                     
                     
                        
                           NDC 82584-792-01
                           1 mL fill in a white polyfoil tube 
     Made in Switzerland
